metadata.case_name: IP LAM YUK LIN v. YEUNG FAT AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: fracture of the left radius (left colle's fracture)
source: She suffered a fracture of the left femur and the left radius.
where a left colle's fracture and left trochanteric fracture were confirmed.
a plaster cast was applied to the left wrist for six weeks
The pain in the left wrist was caused by traumatic tenosynovitis
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of lower end of radius, dorsal tilt

injuries.description: fracture of the left femur (left trochanteric fracture / left hip fracture)
source: She suffered a fracture of the left femur and the left radius.
where a left colle's fracture and left trochanteric fracture were confirmed.
a left D.H.S. performed for the left hip fracture.
the left hip fracture treated by means of a hip compression system
X-ray showed the hip compression system in situ.

manifestations.description: pain in the left wrist caused by traumatic tenosynovitis
itching around the site of the pin in her hip (severe itching)

treatments_received: taken to the Tang Shiu Kin Hospital, then transferred to Queen Mary Hospital
a plaster cast was applied to the left wrist for six weeks
close reduction with plaster of paris for the left wrist
a left D.H.S. performed for the left hip
left hip fracture treated by means of a hip compression system
transferred to Sandy Bay Convalescent Hospital on 10/1/89 for physiotherapy
treatments_future: a steroid injection into the tendon sheath (recommended by Dr. Yeung)

losses.description: Total permanent disability assessed at 3% (2% from the left hip and 1% from the left wrist).

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: She feels no discomfort in her hand, but she cannot lift heavy objects.
She had recovered sufficiently to seek work, but no one was willing to employ her; prospective employers said 'you are crippled, how can you carry on your works.'

comparable_cases.case_name: KUNG Kit-shing v. Star Synthetic Flower Factory and others
comparable_cases.injury_description: Minor injury: three lacerations, short loss of consciousness, and neck pain; returned to job 18 days after the accident; no permanent disability or loss of earning capacity.

Multiple injuries including post-traumatic amnesia of eight hours, fracture of the odontoid process, 2 cm scalp laceration, spinal cord damage at C5-7; hospitalised for two months; underwent traction for 6.5 weeks and wore a Minerva plaster cast for three months.
